page.layout: One page of text, single column, centred; heading in spaced capitals above the privilege paragraph; signatures at right below the text; faint show-through of the reverse page in the background (not transcribed); a faint signature mark at the foot centre (not transcribed).

main_text.head: SVMMA PRIVILEGII REGII.
main_text.p: REGIAE Maiestatis Priuilegio cautum est, Ne quis Iusti Lipsi de Cruce Libros tres vnà cùm Notis, citra voluntatem Ioannis Moreti Typographi Antuerpiensis, intra octennium vllo modo imprimat, vel alibi impressos importet, distrahat, venalésue habeat per omnes eius ditionis fines; qui secus faxit, confiscatione librorum, &graui poena multabitur: vt latiùs patet in litteris datis Bruxellæ, XXIII. Iunij, M. D. XCIII.

page.notes: The initial R is a large woodcut-style letter joined to "EGIAE" (REGIAE). Show-through text from the reverse page is faint and omitted. The tail of the page's bottom area holds faint marks only. The printed text is set in italic for the title "Iusti Lipsi de Cruce Libros tres vnà cùm Notis". Some letters in "Iusti", "Lipsi" and "Notis" are uncertain in the scan but read as shown.
